newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble lower as funds come from state budget.
newsitem.headline: Rouble lower as funds come from state budget.

text.p: The rouble edged down in active trade on Monday as banks invested funds being transferred by the government in dollars, dealers said.
roubles/dollar Mar 3 midday Mar 3 early Feb 28 close

"High rouble volume is set aside for Treasury bill trading so, funds are not coming from that market. Banks may be receiving funds to pay budget arrears and invest them in dollars," ABN Amro Bank dealer Artur Lotov said.

Another dealer said banks were rushing to buy dollars for today settlement, fearing a more expensive rouble on Tuesday before Wednesday's T-bill auctions, which would make dollar investments less attractive.
On Wednesday, the central bank is auctioning 7.5 trillion roubles ($1.3 billion) of six-month paper and an additional tranche of 4.5 trillion roubles of six-month bills.
